_comment: SWE-bench-like tasks: bug-fix, refactor, greenfield. Each task has setup files, a test file, and spec. Scoring runs the test file and checks pass/fail.

tasks.title: Bug-fix: debounce fires immediately instead of after delay
tasks.spec: The debounce function in debounce.mjs has a bug: it fires fn immediately on first call instead of waiting delayMs. Fix it so that fn only fires after delayMs of silence. The timer must be cleared on each call. Do not change the test file.

tasks.title: Refactor: convert callback-based fetchData to async/await
tasks.spec: Refactor fetchData in api.mjs from callback style to async/await. The function should return a Promise that resolves with the data. Remove the callback parameter. Keep the same URL and error handling behavior. Do not change the test file.

tasks.title: Greenfield: implement LRU cache from scratch
tasks.spec: Create an LRU cache class in lru.mjs with get(key) and put(key, value) methods. Capacity is set in constructor. When capacity is exceeded, evict the least recently used item. get marks an item as recently used. Export the class as default. Do not change the test file.
